summary: [Gmail] rate-limits: Official quota reference: per-project 1,200,000 quota units/min; per-user 15,000 units/min. Per-method costs: messages.send 100, drafts.send 100, messages.get/list/modify 5, history.list 2, threads.get 10, watch 100, batchModify 50. rateLimitExceeded/userRateLimitExceeded on exceed; exponential backoff. Daily SENDING additionally capped by Gmail account sending limits (Workspace tiers), independent of API quota.
